questions.text: Under UAP Document 301, what must the architect do within fifteen days after receiving a contractor request for payment?

options.text: Issue a certificate of payment or withhold the request
Automatically pay the contractor
Release the guarantee bond
Declare final acceptance

questions.rationale: Correct because it follows UAP Document 301 lines 69 and 825-827. The other options change the timing, party, document, amount, or legal effect stated in the checked local source.
questions.explanation: Oversimplifies applications; they must include detailed work descriptions and supporting documentation, not just an amount. Confuses claims with minimal support; applications must include supporting documentation substantiating the work and costs claimed. Contradicts the purpose; applications describe past work performed, not future work to be done. Applications for payment include detailed work descriptions, invoices, and documentation supporting the costs claimed. Applications for payment must detail the work performed with supporting documentation like invoices and subcontractor receipts.
